```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, out.width = "150%", out.height = "200%")

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)

path_1 <- "C:/Users/kibi/OneDrive - Danmarks Tekniske Universitet/gits/spr.27.3a4_commercial_catch/output/00_canum_weca_in_present_model/"
path_2 <- "C:/Users/kibi/OneDrive - Danmarks Tekniske Universitet/gits/spr.27.3a4_commercial_catch/output/08_benchmark_2018_2025_rerun_v2/"

file_2 <- "July_to_june_quarterly_catch_in_numbers_and_mean_weight_benchmark_IV.csv"

name_1 <- "present input"
name_2 <- "2025 rerun v1"
```

# Canum

```{r, include = F}
canum_present <- read.csv(paste0(path_1, "canum.csv"), sep = ";", header = T)
canum_present$type <- name_1
canum_present_t <- gather(canum_present, key = age, value = no, , -year, -season, -type)
canum_present_t$age <- substr(canum_present_t$age, 2, 2)

canum <- read.csv(paste0(path_2, file_2), sep = ",")
canum$season <- canum$quarter
canum$type <- name_2
names(canum)
canum <- select(canum, year, season, type, n0, n1, n2, n3)
canum_t <- gather(canum, key = age, value = no, , -year, -season, -type)
canum_t$age <- substr(canum_t$age, 2, 2)


comb <- bind_rows(canum_present_t, canum_t)
```

```{r, echo = F}

ggplot(data = comb, aes(x = year, y = no, col = type)) +
  # geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
  geom_line() +
  facet_grid(age~season, scale = "free_y") +
  labs(title = "Number at age per season and year") +
    theme(legend.position="bottom")
```

# WECA

```{r, include = F}
canum_present <- read.csv(paste0(path_1, "weca.csv"), sep = ";", header = T)
canum_present$type <- name_1
canum_present_t <- gather(canum_present, key = age, value = mw, , -year, -season, -type)
canum_present_t$age <- substr(canum_present_t$age, 3, 3)
canum_present_t$season <- as.numeric(canum_present_t$season)
canum_present_t$year <- as.numeric(canum_present_t$year)

canum <- read.csv(paste0(path_2, file_2), sep = ",")
canum$season <- canum$quarter
canum$type <- name_2
names(canum)
canum <- select(canum, year, season, type, mw0, mw1, mw2, mw3)
canum_t <- gather(canum, key = age, value = mw, , -year, -season, -type)
canum_t$age <- substr(canum_t$age, 3, 3)


comb <- bind_rows(canum_present_t, canum_t)
```

```{r, echo = F}

ggplot(data = comb, aes(x = year, y = mw, col = type)) +
  # geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
  geom_line() +
  facet_grid(season~age, scale = "free_y") +
  labs(title = "Mean weight at age per season and year") +
    theme(legend.position="bottom")
```
